knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Zoning prevents transfer before equipment is moved.
Contamination requires isolation and escalation, not a quick wipe or a colour-code shortcut.
Sanitising and verification are separate steps from visible cleaning.

practicalCriteria: Maps raw-food, ready-to-eat, waste and wash-up zones before moving equipment in a mock kitchen.
Stops and isolates when a mock cross-zone transfer is introduced.
Completes a handover record with method, observations and release decision.
passRule: Zones mapped correctly, cross-zone event stopped and escalated, and handover record complete. Observed by an assessor. Not a food safety qualification.
stopWorkCriteria: Cross-zone transfer that is not isolated
Food present in an area being cleaned
